stem: A site has excellent sun but unreliable midsummer water supply and limited equipment access. What is the strongest decision?
choices: Adjust crop scope or site choice to match dependable water and access constraints before planting
Ignore access because plant biology is the only planning factor
Assume emergency water can always be found later
Increase plant count to offset future losses
rationale: Outdoor site suitability depends on multiple practical constraints, including dependable water and access, not sun alone.
